name: Ankle socks
description: Short white cotton sports socks with grey heels and toes, cut below the ankle bone.
notes: A flat pair, toes outward, each 230 mm heel to toe with a 50 mm cuff: white cotton, grey heel and toe patches and a ribbed cuff. Slot socks is new: socks and stockings are worn under shoes and boots, so the feet slot would stop them being worn together; every sock-like item in this batch takes it. The worn look is pending: clothing gets inventory and ground models only until a fitted worn family exists.

Usage is empty because they are improvised from bags. Two bags laid flat fill a wide thin box. Wear per damage is high because thin plastic splits. Slot socks is new: socks and stockings are worn under shoes and boots, so the feet slot would stop them being worn together; every sock-like item in this batch takes it. name: Six-tube stockings
description: Six long cotton tubes, each closed in a round tip, knitted to keep the cold off limbs far longer and thinner than legs.
notes: Six tubes laid flat side by side, each 750 mm long and 110 mm wide at a white ribbed cuff, tapering to a round tip and ringed with five white stripes on green cotton. They fit a body with six long tentacle-like limbs in place of legs, which Deadvox does not have yet; the item is drafted so such a body can use it when one exists. Usage is empty because they are made by hand. A pair laid flat spreads over a wide thin box. Slot socks is new: socks and stockings are worn under shoes and boots, so the feet slot would stop them being worn together; every sock-like item in this batch takes it.
